description: Human-confirmed clean COBOL-JavaTrans controls from the Phase 6.2A pilot.
creationMethodology: Deterministic size-stratified pilot selection followed by independent CLEAN decisions from two distinct ALSM human reviewers and separate human-authored title, description, and semantic review difficulty.
limitations: CLEAN records human review judgment, not formal equivalence proof, exhaustive input coverage, or production correctness.
The pilot contains only cases where both independent reviewers selected CLEAN; disagreements and non-clean or uncertain cases are excluded pending separate human adjudication.
Size strata are based only on character count and do not represent semantic difficulty.
